# t15 — Checkout, Orders, Account & Points JSPs

## Summary
7 JSP files created, migrating Struts tag libraries (`<html:form>`, `<bean:write>`, `<logic:iterate>`, etc.) to JSTL (`<c:out>`, `<c:forEach>`, `<c:if>`) with `_csrfToken` hidden fields for Spring Security CSRF. All follow the t6 layout pattern (full HTML document, header/footer includes, messages fragment). Build passes, all JSPs packaged in JAR.
